---
name: Feature request
about: Something the factory should do and does not
labels: enhancement
---

**What you were trying to do**, and where the factory stopped being able to help.

**What you want it to do.**

**What you tried instead.** A pipeline is a lot of rope — a `run:` step, a different edge, a
prompt change — and if one of those nearly worked, say how it fell short.

**Why it belongs in the tool.** `docs/internals.md` lists what was deliberately left out
and when each omission stops being one; if this is on that list, say what changed.
